== Description ==

[[Steve Harpster]] (front left, white hair, grey stubble, black zip jacket over grey tee), [[Chris Wirfs]] (back left, black Solo tee, glasses, missing right forearm), and [[Apollo Chu]] (right edge, hands holding blue-sleeved cards, blue tee) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
